data.body: **P2:** Fatal continuations may still publish after success closes admission, and an ordinary failure selected immediately before closing can also publish afterward because completion occurs outside the lock. For a >6 MB result, this completes `executionExceptionFuture` before the final `EXECUTION/SUCCEED` checkpoint; `CheckpointManager` then silently skips that update, while `handleLargePayload` returns `""` and the invocation reports success without persisting its result. Atomically arbitrate success against continuation failure before output preparation: reject all post-close invocation-control publications and surface any failure that won first. Add a race test with blocked oversized-result preparation and an in-flight continuation failure.
